question: _________ won the gold medal in the Women's event in the 44th Chess Olympiad 2022 held in India.
solution:
Correct answer is __Ukraine__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **India hosted the Chess Olympiad for the first time.**
 
• It consisted of open and women’s tournaments.
 
• The opening and closing ceremonies were held at the **Jawaharlal Nehru Stadium.**
 
• The 44th Chess Olympiad was organised by the **International Chess Federation or World Chess Federation (FIDE) in Chennai, India from July 28 to August 09, 2022.**
 
• **Ukraine won the gold medal in the women's section of the 44th Chess Olympiad.**
 
• Team Armenia won silver while the** India-2 team settled for bronze in Open Section.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• The **Chess Olympiad is an international chess competition between national teams.**
 
• **The first Chess Olympiad was held in Paris in 1927.**
 
• The Chess Olympiad is** held every two years.**
 
• The current world champion, **Magnus Carlsen, has won the Chess Olympiad three times.**
 
• The most successful country in the **Chess Olympiad is the Soviet Union, which has won 25 titles.**​
